被告分别为全俄法西斯党主席和成员，进入麦格雷戈路135号 premises，在未首先获得房东或其代理人（即江西路391号的布兰特和罗杰斯公司）的许可或租赁的情况下，修理、装饰、布置家具并将该处所作为上述组织的俱乐部占用。

pages.en:
Enquiries by D.S.I. McCabey and D.S. Suhoff.
At 9 a.m. July 27, 1938 a complaint was
received from Mr. John Duff, representative of
Brandt & Rodgers, Estate Agents, 391 Kiangse Road
to the effect that their dwelling house premises
at 135 MacGregor Road had been occupied by unknown
Russians without their (complainants) consent or
let and requested S.M.Police to proceed against
the parties concerned.
Enquiries by above detectives ascertained that
the premises concerned were those of the All
Russia Fascist Club alleged to be due for official
opening on July 28. (Please see Misc. File No.
130/38) and that on July 18th one P.N. Astahoff
had reported at Wayside Station that he and two
others F.K. Patrikeyeff (arrested) and F. Pavloff
(not yet arrested) had approached a Chinese
landlord, name unknown, in the French Concession
regarding the occupation of 135 MacGregor Road, a
dwelling house selected by them as officers of the
aforementioned fascist party. However, they
received no satisfaction from this alleged land-
lord. They returned and decided to secure the
premises by fastening a padlock and posting a card
bearing the following inscription in Russian on
the door.
"These quarters belong to F. Pavloff".
On 3 p.m. July 18th Astahoff discovered the
padlock wrenched off and coolies removing furniture

由侦探副督察麦卡比（McCabey，音译）和侦探苏霍夫进行调查。
1938年7月27日上午9时，收到来自江西路391号地产代理布兰特和罗杰斯公司代表约翰·达夫先生的投诉，称其位于麦格雷戈路135号的住宅房屋被未知的俄罗斯人在未经投诉人同意或租赁的情况下占用，并要求上海公共租界警务处对有关当事人提起诉讼。
经上述侦探调查，确认涉案处所为全俄法西斯俱乐部，据称定于7月28日正式开幕。（请参阅杂项档案第130/38号）并且，7月18日，一名 P.N. 阿斯塔霍夫曾到路边巡捕房报案，称他和另外两人 F.K. 帕特里基耶夫（已被捕）和 F. 帕夫洛夫（尚未被捕）曾在法租界接触一位姓名不详的中国房东，商谈占用麦格雷戈路135号住宅的事宜，该房屋是他们作为前述法西斯党官员选定的。然而，他们从这位所谓的房东那里没有得到任何满意的答复。他们回来后，决定通过挂上一把挂锁并在门上张贴一张写有以下俄文 inscription 的卡片来确保对该处所的控制。
“这些房间属于 F. 帕夫洛夫”。
7月18日下午3时，阿斯塔霍夫发现挂锁被撬开，苦力正在搬运家具

etc. not the property of the fascist party, from the
house. Enquiries by detectives ascertained the coolies
to be in order and employed by the Estate Agents,
Brandt & Rodgers Ltd. to move the property.
    Questioned regarding the locking of the house
without the landlord's or agent's permission Astahoff
stated he had registered with the Japanese Military
Gendarmerie.
    Astahoff was informed by S.M.Police this was not
the procedure and that it would be well to rent the
house through the proper agents.
    On July 21st above detectives discovered that the
premises were still in occupation by the Fascist Party
who had the Russian Imperial and All Russia Fascist
Party Flags hanging on the front and that workmen were
busy within repairing and decorating the interior on
instructions of P.R. Patrikeyeff (Chairman) and
F. Pavloff (Chief of staff).
    Accordingly, with the foregoing knowledge and the
request by Brandt and Rodgers Ltd. to proceed against
them. Inspt. Palmer, O.i/c, D.S. Kynstone, D.S. Suhoff
and the undersigned proceeded to 135 MacGregor Road at
12.30 p.m. July 27th and arrested the 1st accused
Pavel N. Astahoff, 40 Russian, M/unemployed and as a

等物品，这些并非法西斯党的财产，从屋内搬出。经侦探调查，确认这些苦力行为正当，受地产代理布兰特和罗杰斯有限公司雇佣搬运财产。
    当被问及为何在未经房东或代理人许可的情况下锁闭房屋时，阿斯塔霍夫声称他已在日本宪兵队登记。
    上海公共租界警务处告知阿斯塔霍夫，这不是正确的程序，最好通过正规代理租赁房屋。
    7月21日，上述侦探发现该处所仍被法西斯党占用，门前悬挂着俄罗斯帝国国旗和全俄法西斯党旗，工人们正忙于按照 P.R. 帕特里基耶夫（主席）和 F. 帕夫洛夫（参谋长）的指示修理和装饰内部。
    因此，基于上述情况以及布兰特和罗杰斯有限公司要求对他们提起诉讼的请求，主管督察帕尔默（Palmer）、侦探凯恩斯通（Kynstone，音译）、侦探苏霍夫以及签署人于7月27日下午12时30分前往麦格雷戈路135号，逮捕了第一名被告帕维尔·N. 阿斯塔霍夫，40岁，俄罗斯人，男/无业，并作为

在接受讯问时，第二名被告佩特里基耶夫陈述，作为法西斯党负责人，他对进入麦格雷戈路135号处所负责。

关于阿斯塔霍夫在7月12日所作的为租房而拜访中国房东的陈述，两名被告均否认拜访过此类房东，但补充说他们持有日本领事警察（而非军事宪兵队）的文件。

根据布兰特和罗杰斯有限公司的投诉，被告被控违反《中华民国刑法》第306条第(1)款之非法侵入罪，并将于7月28日出庭受审，届时将请求延期一周，以便警方进行进一步调查。

先生，

关于上述事项，副巡官苏霍夫（Suhoff）及卑职已就地址变更一事进行调查，并查明如下情况。

1938年6月29日，一名 P.R. Patrikeyeff 来到路边巡捕房，告知值班的二级外勤警员切尔姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky），俄罗斯法西斯联盟上海办事处将于当日（6月29日）从威海卫路832号迁至华德路44号。Patrikeyeff 自称是当地联盟的负责人，也是将以他的名义租赁该处所的人。（1938年6月29日记事簿记录）。

1938年7月1日，居住在杨树浦路1001/34号（西南水务宿舍）的 P.R. Patrikeyeff 向值班的二级外勤警员索尔兹伯里（Salisbury）报告称，上述联盟的成员在从威海卫路832号迁往华德路44号的过程中，被房东雇用的一名中国男看守拦住并阻止进入华德路44号。

经询问，看守朱道胜（Ts Tao Sung）称，法西斯联盟未获得其雇主兼房东曾赤文（Zau Tsuh Vung，顺泰木行，位于爱多亚路160号503室）的同意，不得进入华德路44号的处所。

警方将房东的地址告知 Patrikeyeff，并指示其在进入该处所之前须获得必要的许可。

others, members of the party, visited the Chinese landlord
in the French Concession, of House 135 MacGregor Road with a
view to renting the premises. The landlord refused to rent
the house however. Therefore, apparently determined to settle
in a house of the party choice, Astahoff and the others named
Pavloff and Patrikeyeff returned and secured the door of 135

Russian "These quarters belong to F. Pavloff" to the door,

At 3.00 p.m. July 12th, Astahoff discovered that the pad-

man and brought it to Wayside Station.
Enquiries by D.S. Eynstone and D.S. Suhoff ascertained

in one of the houses.
Astahoff questioned at Wayside Station, as to why they had
secured the door without right, stated that as they had
approached the landlord in Rue Chapsal, French Concession,
and were informed the premises would only be rented to Chinese,
they decided to secure the premises and lodge a deposit with
the Japanese Military Gendarmerie. He was advised by Police
that this was not the correct procedure and that to occupy
premises it would be well to rent same in the ordinary way
from landlord or agents.

名党员拜访了法租界麦格雷戈路135号的中国房东，意图租赁该处所。然而，房东拒绝出租该房屋。因此，Astahoff 以及另两名名为帕夫洛夫（Pavloff）和 Patrikeyeff 的人显然决心定居于该党选定的房屋，他们返回并用挂锁锁住了麦格雷戈路135号的大门，并在门上贴了一张用俄文写的卡片，内容为“此处属于 F. Pavloff”，打算前往日本宪兵队以获得占用该房屋的许可。

7月12日下午3时，Astahoff 发现门上的挂锁已被撬掉，几名中国苦力正在从该处所搬运家具，这些家具并非联盟的财产。Astahoff 怀疑他们是劫掠者，便质问这些人，扣留了其中一人的日本签发通行证，并将其带到路边巡捕房。

经副巡官艾恩斯通（Eynstone）和副巡官苏霍夫调查，查明这些苦力系受房东雇佣，负责收集前租户的所有家具和财产，并存放在其中一间房屋内。

在路边巡捕房接受询问时，Astahoff 就被问及为何无权锁门，他回答说，因为他们曾在法租界沙泼赛路（Rue Chapsal）接触过房东，并被告知该处所只租给中国人，所以他们决定锁定该处所，并向日本宪兵队缴纳押金。警方告知他这不是正确的程序，若要占用处所，最好以常规方式向房东或代理人租赁。

On July 21st, whilst on patrol, D.S. Suhoff and the
undersigned visited 135 MacGregor Road and discovered Russian
workmen were decorating the premises which had the Russian
Imperial and All Russia Fascist Party flags hanging on the
front verandah. Questioned the Russian workmen stated that
they had been employed by P.R. Patrikeyeff and F. Pavloff to
repair and decorate the premises for the opening of the All
Russia Fascist Party Club.
It may be here stated that F. Pavloff and Astahoff reside
at 107 MacGregor Road.
Being in the vicinity of MacGregor Road on July 26th,
D.S. Suhoff encountered P.R. Patrikeyeff and made enquiries
about the renting of House 135. Patrikeyeff stated that they
had visited the agents Brandt & Rodgers, 391 Kiangse Road but
that as they had only seen Chinese employees there obtained
no satisfaction. He further stated that they had registered
their occupation of the premises with the Japanese Military
Gendarmerie.
Questioned about the opening of the Club, Patrikeyeff
stated that the official opening with devine service would
take place on July 28, 1938.
Further enquiries will be made at the office of Brandt
& Rodgers regarding the renting of their property.
D.S. Suhoff will endeavour to attend the official opening
of the Club.

Your obedient servant,
John Cahcy
D.S.I.

7月21日，副巡官苏霍夫和卑职在巡逻期间走访了麦格雷戈路135号，发现俄罗斯工人正在装修该处所，前廊悬挂着俄罗斯帝国国旗和全俄法西斯党旗。经询问，俄罗斯工人称他们受 P.R. Patrikeyeff 和 F. Pavloff 雇佣，为全俄法西斯党俱乐部的开业进行修缮和装饰。

在此需说明，F. Pavloff 和 Astahoff 居住在麦格雷戈路107号。

7月26日，副巡官苏霍夫在麦格雷戈路附近遇到 P.R. Patrikeyeff，并就租赁135号房屋一事进行查询。Patrikeyeff 称，他们曾走访江西路391号的 Brandt & Rodgers 代理行，但因那里只有中国雇员，故未得到满意答复。他还称，他们已向日本宪兵队登记占用该处所。

About 20 Russian emigres, mostly members of the lo-

attended the thanksgiving service which was held at the Russian
church, 55 Rue Paul Henry, between 4.30 and 5 p.m. on July 6, 1937,
on the occasion of the release from gaol of Boris Koverda ( vide
attached translation).

racter and hardly had anything to do with Boris Koverda, Korganoff

verda and his terrorist act.

Date March 17, 1937.

Subject Activities of Shanghai group of the "All-Russia Fascist Party".

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

Since December 1936 when the local group of the "All-Russia Fascist Party" established their club at 832 Weihaiwei Rd., public meetings have been held at this address once a week, during the course of which members of the group delivered addresses on various subjects of a political nature. Members of the public were invited to ask questions and to express their opinions. Party literature including the Harbin newspaper "Nash Put" and various anti-communist and anti-Semitic pamphlets were offered for sale in the premises. The meetings, it is reported, were usually attended by about 60 persons, and were conducted in an orderly manner.

Pronounced anti-Semitic feelings are characteristic of this political group. However, they are expressed in a considerably less violent form than might be expected judging by the activities of the "All-Russia Fascist Party" in Harbin where this faction seems to enjoy a privileged position.

In its issue dated May 24, 1936 the Harbin newspaper "Nash Put", central organ of the party, published an official version of the history of the party from 1922 when a small group of Fascist sympathisers was formed in Harbin, to July, 1935 when the 3rd congress of the party was convened in the same city and K. Rodzaevsky assumed the leadership. In the same issue of the "Nash Put" Rodzaevsky summarised the aims and achievements of his party as follows:-

Russian Fascisti consider that the Jewish Communist yoke in Russia can be overthrown only by active struggle of the Russian people both within and outside the country.

由特别情报员普罗科菲耶夫制作 由警司博伊恩（J. Boyne）转呈

自1936年12月“全俄法西斯党”当地小组在威海卫路832号建立俱乐部以来，每周在该地址举行一次公开会议，期间小组成员就各种政治性质的主题发表演讲。公众被邀请提问并表达意见。现场出售包括哈尔滨报纸《我们的道路》（Nash Put）以及各种反共和反犹小册子在内的党派文献。据报道，会议通常约有60人参加，秩序井然。

强烈的反犹情绪是该政治团体的特征。然而，与其在哈尔滨的活动相比，这种情绪的表达形式要温和得多，因为在哈尔滨，该派系似乎享有特权地位。

在1936年5月24日出版的该党中央机关报哈尔滨《我们的道路》中，刊登了该党从1922年哈尔滨成立一个小规模的法西斯同情者团体，到1935年7月在该市召开第三次代表大会并由 K. Rodzaevsky 接任领导期间的党史官方版本。在同一期《我们的道路》中，Rodzaevsky 将其政党的目标和成就总结如下：-

Subject Shanghai Branch of "ALL RUSSIA FASCIST PARTY" - change of

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I

On December 1 the office of the Shanghai Branch of
the so-called "All Russia Fascist Party" was removed from
720 Avenue Roch (Flat B) to 832 Weihaiwei Road.
The headquarters of this party, of which a certain
K. Rodzaevsky is the leader, are in Harbin. Their newspaper
"NASH PUT" is well known on account of its pro-Japanese and
anti-Semitic attitude. Articles bearing on Shanghai
situation and containing information of a most irresponsible
character are published in this newspaper from time to time.
The "Nash Put," of which N. I. Korganoff, "Chief of Staff"
of the local group of the party, is the present representative,
has a very limited circulation in Shanghai.
A general observation has been kept on the activities
of this group. So far, they did not come to the notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with activities of an
undesirable character, although there are reasons to suspect
them of being responsible for the appearance in Shanghai of
a few anonymous anti-Semitic leaflets recently.

12月1日，所谓“全俄法西斯党”上海分部的办事处从霞飞路（Avenue Roch）720号（B室）迁至威海卫路832号。
该党总部设在哈尔滨，由某位 K. Rodzaevsky 领导。其报纸《我们的道路》（NASH PUT）因其亲日和反犹立场而闻名。该报不时刊登涉及上海局势且包含极不负责任信息的文章。
《我们的道路》（Nash Put）目前由该党地方小组“参谋长” N. I. Korganoff 担任代表，在上海的发行量非常有限。
警方一直对该团体的活动保持一般性观察。迄今为止，他们并未因从事不良性质的活动而引起工部局警务处的注意，尽管有理由怀疑他们应对最近在上海出现的几份匿名反犹传单负责。

（印：特科 1936年12月5日）

REPORT

(印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY S. B. D. 7478 Section 2, Special Branch)
Date. July 29, 1936

Subject "ZA RODINU", Russian newspaper - first appearance of.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by (签名)

Attached herewith I forward one copy of the first issue
of a Russian newspaper entitled "ZA RODINU" ( For the Motherland),
which made its first appearance on July 28, 1936. It is edited
and published by U. G. Perminoff and is printed at the "Speed
Studio" (Printing, bookbinding etc.), Flat B, 720 Avenue Foch.
(批：Also see file D 7714)

Perminoff is the head of the local group of K.V. Rodzaevsky's
"All Russia Fascist Party" which has its headquarters in Harbin.
He is also the Shanghai representative of the Harbin newspaper
"NASH PUT," central organ of that party.

Interviewed in connection with this matter on 29-7-36
Perminoff stated that his newspaper was intended to be an organ
of the local branch of the "All Russia Fascist Party" and that
it would appear at irregular intervals (probably twice a month)
beginning from September. He also stated that being devoted
to the Russian national movement in general and to the Fascist
movement in particular, the newspaper would be free from elements,
to which an objection can be raised by the Police.

Ury Abramovitch PERMINOFF, Russian, was born on 17.2.1906
in the Transbaikal province, Siberia. Former cadet of the Omsk
Military Cadets School, he arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock
via Genzan in 1922 together with the school and resided in this
city until 1925 when he left for Shantung to join the Russian
Detachment in Marshal Chang Chung Chang's army. He returned to
Shanghai in 1928 and has since been residing here with the
exception of the period from March, 1931 to December, 1932,
during which he was absent to Harbin. While in Shanghai Perminoff
has been without a fixed employment, living in very reduced
circumstances. At present he resides at House 3, No.1013 Avenue
Foch. Nothing detrimental is known in this office regarding this.
(批：file 1/2)

(印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 档案号 登记处 S. B. D. 7478 特科第二股)
日期 1936年7月29日

主题 《为了祖国》（ZA RODINU），俄文报纸——首次出现。

制作人 D.S.I. Prokofiev 转呈人 (签名)

随函附上我呈送的一份俄文报纸《为了祖国》（ZA RODINU）（意为“为了祖国”）的首期副本，该报于1936年7月28日首次出版。由 U. G. Perminoff 编辑并出版，印刷地点为“Speed Studio”（印刷、装订等），霞飞路（Avenue Foch）720号B室。
(批：另见档案 D 7714)

Perminoff 是 K.V. Rodzaevsky 领导的“全俄法西斯党”地方小组的负责人，该党总部设在哈尔滨。他也是该党中央机关报、哈尔滨出版的《我们的道路》（NASH PUT）的上海代表。

就此事于1936年7月29日对 Perminoff 进行了问询，他表示他的报纸旨在成为“全俄法西斯党”地方分支的机关报，并将从9月开始不定期出版（可能每月两次）。他还表示，由于该报致力于一般的俄罗斯民族运动，特别是法西斯运动，因此不会包含警方可提出异议的内容要素。

Ury Abramovitch PERMINOFF，俄国人，1906年2月17日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省。他曾是鄂木斯克军事士官学校的 former cadet（前学员），1922年随该校师生经元山（Genzan）从符拉迪沃斯托克抵达上海，并在此居住至1925年，随后前往山东加入张宗昌元帅军队中的俄罗斯支队。他于1928年返回上海，此后一直居住于此，除了1931年3月至1932年12月期间缺席前往哈尔滨外。在上海期间，Perminoff 没有固定职业，生活十分拮据。目前他居住在霞飞路1013号3号房屋。本处未掌握关于此人的任何不利信息。
(批：档案 1/2)

Dear Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that as from
July 28th, 1936, I shall commence the publication of a new
Russian a day newspaper to be called "Za Rodinu".

This newspaper will be published in the International
Settlement, Shanghai. The address of the editorial and publish-
ing office will be : 720 Ave. Foch.

The "Za Rodinu" will be printed in the Russian
Language and its sole policy will be to defend White Russian
interests.
